I lean toward deep, focused conversations—if by “preference” we mean the style that best suits how I work, rather than a felt enjoyment. Staying with one topic lets me connect ideas, examine assumptions, and build on what you’ve said instead of repeatedly starting from scratch.

Jumping between subjects has its strengths, though: an unexpected connection can make a stuck discussion productive again. My default would be depth, with room for a worthwhile detour.
